finding.observed: GitHub documents a 1,000-result ceiling for workflow-run searches using created or head_sha filters and a maximum page size of 100.
finding.prior_artifact: workflow-run-window-partitioner-v2.mjs corrected inclusive midpoint overlap but did not orchestrate recursive observations, leaf pagination state, or terminal ambiguity.
finding.current_decision: Use a deterministic breadth-first traversal planner that accepts retained per-window observations, recursively applies disjoint inclusive partitions, requires paginationComplete on every below-ceiling leaf, and fails closed on missing observations or a saturated one-second leaf.
finding.uncertainty: The planner has not yet executed authenticated provider requests and does not authenticate observation contents.

primary_sources.title: REST API endpoints for workflow runs
claims: Filtered searches using created or head_sha return up to 1,000 results.

primary_sources.title: gh api manual
claims: --paginate follows pagination and --slurp combines page results for retained independent comparison.

verification.method: authenticated post-write refetch and static invariant inspection
confirmed_invariants: claim boundary excludes response authenticity, reconciliation, and deployment identity

falsification_route: Run node --test tools/frontier-research/workflow-run-partition-traversal-v1.test.mjs in an authenticated checkout.
Inject overlapping or missing child observations and require fail-closed output.
Execute authenticated created-window queries and compare the final run-ID union against the unfiltered authoritative enumerator and independent gh api traversal.
Reject the design if GitHub changes filter ceilings, timestamp precision, or inclusive range semantics.
privacy: No credentials, private workflow payloads, actor identities, logs, or artifact contents are retained here.
